### 🐛 Describe the bug

# Bug I met
Deploying FunASR-Nano with fp16 data type, the inference results are abnormal.
# reproduce
## Download model from modelscope(or from hf)
```bash
modelscope download --model allendou/Fun-ASR-Nano-2512-vllm
```
## Run server
```bash
vllm serve ~/.cache/modelscope/models/allendou--Fun-ASR-Nano-2512-vllm/snapshots/master/ --served-model-name fun-asr-n
ano --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8899 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.40 --enforce-eager --dtype float16
```

## Download request file
zh.mp3 from hf, download cmd:
```bash
curl -fL https://huggingface.co/allendou/Fun-ASR-Nano-2512-vllm/resolve/e718b36e2578203ec893e9b488239225f8d668e2/example/zh.mp3 -o zh.mp3 && echo "0e64de19e4ff9a02e682955c9112f32d2317cfdbb5bc2f3504664044c993f195  zh.mp3" | sha256sum -c -
```
## Start request:
```bash
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8899/v1/audio/transcriptions -F file=@zh.mp3 -F model=fun-asr-nano -F language=zh -F response_format=json
```
## The result I got:
```txt
{"text":"起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起","usage":{"type":"duration","seconds":6}}
```
Expected:
```txt
{"text":"开饭时间早上九点至下午五点。","usage":{"type":"duration","seconds":6}}(funasr)
```
